scope: Finite deterministic checks under the pinned trace interpreter; not a proof for all inputs or a human review.

practice_checks.misconception: The last position is never visited.
One bound update can leave the candidate interval unchanged.
The comparison moves values in the wrong direction.
The shift condition builds the wrong order.
The suffix scan selects the wrong extreme.
Source values are overwritten before later placements.
The duplicate path returns the wrong result.
The pivot never reaches the returned position.
The crossing check returns before the partition is complete.
